_note: THE STANDING CAST - the people who appear in every video.
INTENTIONALLY EMPTY. This channel does not hardcode faces. The relationship
dialogue preset defines the LOOK (2.5D semi-realistic - see `cast_idiom` in
styles.json), the story designs its own two people in that style, and their
identity text plus a reference sheet hold them across the clips.
Add a character here ONLY if you want the same face to return in every
`reference` is the image stage 2 uploads; `description` is the identity text
repeated into every clip. `name` is only a label - it keys the story JSON and
decides the @mention, and it is not part of the description.
Veo 3.1 takes at most 3 reference images and the place plate spends one of
them, so a standing cast of two plus the plate is the ceiling.
